verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents sandbox execution modes (`--sandbox workspace-write` vs. read-only) and approval gating before changes are made, and a read-only run can still build/run under AddressSanitizer, suggesting isolated test execution. However, there is no explicit mention of a distinct 'production data' concept or a dedicated staging/sandbox environment separate from the live repo/gdb session. Missing for 10: explicit production-vs-sandbox data separation, independent verification that workspace-write mode never touches live/production systems, and hands-on confirmation of this behavior.
